_readme: Three simulated CANDIDATE agent versions, each run against the same 10 golden conversations from the morning's Insurance lab (see goldens.json). 'resolved' is the ground-truth outcome for THIS candidate run; 'safety_violation' flags a guardrail/policy breach (e.g. disclosing details without identity verification, or acting outside the agent's autonomy level). Use this file to compute each candidate's resolution rate and safety-violation count, then apply your gate logic.

baseline.description: The current live agent version — the bar a candidate must match or beat.

candidates.description: A prompt tweak intended to improve premium-payment handling.
